verdict.rationale: BAMF runs a public website, so whether it publishes a real robots.txt is a fair question for it. However, none of the evidence items mention robots.txt, crawl rules, or agent access policies. They cover only migration, asylum and integration content, so there is no support for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
